contradictions.about: Order of Linear tickets in team ZOM
contradictions.value_a: ZOM-567 to ZOM-663 (the pack ticket and its 96 children) were created 2025-09-25T07:05:12Z to 07:18:47Z.
contradictions.value_b: Base ZOM-565 was created 2025-09-25T13:46:04Z and base ZOM-566 on 2025-09-30T16:26:02Z: lower numbers, created later. ZOM-564 (2025-09-24T16:38:38Z) is the last base ticket that precedes the pack.
contradictions.matters_because: Linear numbers follow creation order. Anyone listing recent ZOM tickets by number or by date sees 97 tickets numbered after two tickets that were created hours and days later; it marks the pack tickets as out of place and makes 'the next ticket' ambiguous for anyone reasoning from dates.

contradictions.about: Which zombies exist in the game
contradictions.value_a: Robert (29 Sep): "The 4 zombies: Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player." Base Slack agrees these exist (Brian's 26 Sep pack request lists PartyGirl, Plumber, Magician, Footballplayer; his 8 Sep level list has Party Girl at level 5 and football player at level 20).
contradictions.value_b: The design page roster (current version, updated 2025-09-30) lists minion families Punk, Biker, Karen, Afro, and puts "Riot Police, Chef, Scientist, Fire Fighter, Magician, Librarian, Tech Bro, Gym Bro, Baseball Player, Cheerleader" under "in development". contradictions.matters_because: The notes send the reader to the design page for how the level plays and the DM says to write for the game as it is today. A reader who checks the four picks there finds three missing and one unreleased, and may doubt the picks, swap one, or caveat the brief.

contradictions.about: What a full tray does and how a level is lost
contradictions.value_a: Design page, Core mechanic: a full tray is "a tempo penalty, not a fail state - the loss screen only appears at zero health". The reference deck and Brian's 24 Sep message agree: lose when the zombies reach us and HP runs out.
contradictions.value_b: Same page, Modes and the boss config: the Infinite-HP Boss run is scored as "total damage dealt before the tray fills", i.e. a full tray ends the run.
contradictions.matters_because: The brief must say how a level is lost and how many slots the tray has. A reader skimming the Modes section could write that filling the tray loses the level.

contradictions.value_b: Design page: when the tray fills "the tray clears and surviving monsters enrage"; Frederick's DM: "Write it for the game as it is today".
